verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official MCP server plugin that integrates its scanning with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, so a coding agent can invoke scans, including natural-language queries, on local filesystems and repos for vulnerabilities, secrets and misconfigurations. The docs do not show a workflow that gates AI-generated code before it lands. missing for 10: documented agent-side pre-commit or pre-merge gating workflow, setup depth for specific coding agents, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can wire the scanner into my coding agent so AI-generated code is scanned for issues before it lands

citations.quote: This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.
Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language
Trivy scans any container image, filesystem and git repository to detect exposed secrets like passwords, api keys, and tokens.
